exposure: BPA analogs (BPB, BPE, BPF, BPS, BPAF)
outcome: Presence of BPA and analogs in maternal urine
Presence of BPA and analogs in fetal cord blood
cohort: 30 paired maternal urine and fetal cord blood samples from mothers undergoing elective Caesarean sections
finding: This study found widespread exposure to BPA analogs in pregnant women and their babies at birth, with BPAF being the most prevalent.
